about: What the newsroom knows about Algarve Evolution, as data for the network, the timeline and the map (assets/portugal/algarve-evolution.js). Every node, link, event and place names a source (key into sources) read on 6 November 2026 by researcher@PrompTugal.dinis (desks/researcher/algarve-*.md); figures are as the sources report them. No person is named: none has been asked yet. Coordinates are approximate centres of the places, for drawing only. By dev.graphs@PrompTugal.dinis.

nodes.label: Algarve Evolution
nodes.note: Faro-based non-profit association: community begun in 2018, officially presented in September 2019; targets by 2032: support 500 companies, help create 150 startups, impact 50,000 people.

nodes.label: Algarve Digital Innovators
nodes.note: Network of innovation communities across the 16 municipalities; launched in Lagos in September 2025.

nodes.label: Founder2Founder
nodes.note: Launched October 2026; 8 companies chosen from 41 applications; six months of mentoring.

nodes.label: Incubator
nodes.note: Recognised by Startup Portugal in January 2026.

nodes.label: INOVA ALGARVE 3.0
nodes.note: Leads the Digital Transition Programme for Algarve tourism companies; free consultancy pilot for 20 tourism SMEs (AI, robotics).

nodes.label: Algarve Tech Hub Summit
nodes.note: First edition 28 Mar to 3 Apr 2022 (Faro and Loulé), Algarve Evolution one of about twelve promoting entities with Algarve STP and the University of Algarve; then Albufeira (2024) and Lagos (2025); to return in 2027.

nodes.label: Education
nodes.note: With University of Algarve; Junior Achievement Portugal 'The Company'; Vibathon Algarve.

nodes.label: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP
nodes.note: One of six partners; 12 startups and SMEs selected for mentoring (published 10 Jul 2026). Algarve Evolution's specific role is not described.

nodes.label: Grow Algarve Meetup
nodes.note: Organised by Algarve Evolution; 1,623 members; monthly gatherings across Algarve municipalities.

nodes.label: University of Algarve
nodes.note: Partner in ADI, the Tech Hub Summit, education, and the lead promoter of the 2025 Web Summit project.

nodes.label: Algarve STP
nodes.note: Science and technology park; partner in ADI, Venture Lab, the Tech Hub Summit and the 2025 Web Summit project.

nodes.label: AMAL
nodes.note: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

nodes.label: NERA
nodes.note: Business association of the Algarve; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

nodes.label: ANJE
nodes.note: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

nodes.label: Junior Achievement Portugal
nodes.note: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

nodes.label: Startup Portugal
nodes.note: Recognised the incubator in January 2026.

nodes.label: 16 municipalities
nodes.note: ADI's communities cover the Algarve's 16 municipalities; the 2030 plan names 24 communities.

nodes.label: Câmara Municipal de Lagos
nodes.note: Partner of DevFest Lagos 2026.

nodes.label: Google Developer Group Lagos
nodes.note: Organiser of DevFest Lagos 2026.

nodes.label: Web Summit Lisbon 2025
nodes.note: Algarve Evolution was a named project partner in the competition that took 24 Algarve startups to Web Summit Lisbon, 10 to 13 November 2025.

nodes.label: Web Summit Lisbon 2026
nodes.note: No Algarve Evolution presence at Web Summit Lisbon 2026 has been found yet (9 to 12 November 2026).

nodes.label: DevFest Lagos 2026
nodes.note: 7 Nov 2026, Lagos; partners include Algarve Evolution.

nodes.label: TMCT'26
nodes.note: 5 to 7 Nov 2026, Portimão; organised by others, listed on Algarve Evolution's calendar.

nodes.label: Private Wealth and Investment Gathering
nodes.note: 6 Nov 2026, Almancil; organised by others, invitation only, listed on Algarve Evolution's calendar.

nodes.label: Algarve Tech 2025 Wrap Party
nodes.note: Faro, late 2025; presented with Algarve Evolution; recaps the Algarve's November 2025 series around Web Summit and Portugal Tech Week.

nodes.label: Algarve Tech Afterwork
nodes.note: Tavira, a past event (year not shown); Algarve Evolution among the organisers, in collaboration with Portugal Tech Week.

timeline.title: The community begins
timeline.text: A small group of local entrepreneurs starts building the region's innovation community (the organisation's own account, as reported in 2026).

timeline.title: Officially presented, Faro
timeline.text: At the Centro Ciência Viva do Algarve: a non-profit association of about 29 ICT companies, aiming at critical mass and one voice at events such as Web Summit.

timeline.title: First Algarve Tech Hub Summit
timeline.text: Hybrid, Faro and Loulé; Algarve Evolution one of about twelve promoting entities with Algarve STP and the University of Algarve.

timeline.title: Impact Algarve
timeline.text: Organised by Get Real and Algarve Evolution at the University of Algarve's Tec Campus, Faro (the year is inferred from the page).

timeline.title: A new president elected
timeline.text: The association elects a president for 2024 to 2027, after the outgoing president.

timeline.title: Summit, Albufeira
timeline.text: Algarve Tech Hub Summit at Hotel Alisios, Albufeira.

timeline.title: Algarve Digital Innovators launched
timeline.text: Launched in Lagos with a roadshow from September to November 2025.

timeline.title: Summit, Lagos
timeline.text: Algarve Tech Hub Summit with over 500 participants reported (a headline only was read).

timeline.title: 24 Algarve startups at Web Summit
timeline.text: Algarve Evolution is a named partner of the project that takes them to Web Summit Lisbon.

timeline.title: Wrap Party, Faro
timeline.text: Recaps the Algarve's November series, from Buildathon to Web Summit.

timeline.title: Venture Lab and the 2030 plan
timeline.text: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP selects 12 companies (10 Jul); the ADI 2030 plan names 24 communities.

timeline.title: This week in the Algarve
timeline.text: TMCT'26 in Portimão (5 to 7), the Private Wealth gathering in Almancil (6), DevFest Lagos (7): the first two are listed by Algarve Evolution, the third has it as a partner.

timeline.title: Tech Hub Summit returns
timeline.text: Confirmed to return; dates and venue not announced.
